raster_policy.rule: Every experiment begins at raster 1. Every raster has a pass/reject decision. If raster 1, 2, 3, 4 or 5 rejects, fails, lacks sufficient evidence, detects an invalid hypothesis, encounters a technical blocker, or otherwise cannot honestly pass its responsibility, the same experiment returns immediately to raster 1. Raster 1 diagnoses the recorded reason, preserves valid research memory, applies only safe repairs or reset actions, and the pipeline starts again from 1. Only a candidate that passes 1 through 5 reaches raster 6. Raster 6 judges the completed blind ten-day experiment. A valid trading MISS below 200 is durable learning evidence, completes that experiment, and starts the next experiment again at raster 1. A valid HIT at or above 200 saves proof but does not stop research: the system continues on untouched blind windows to measure and improve repeat HIT-rate.

ordered_rasters.purpose: Inspect current technical state, checkpoints, data and prior rejection/failure. Localize the cause, preserve valid memory, apply only whitelisted repair/reset actions and restart the same run from raster 1. Never choose or score trading ideas.
Use only the preceding 365 days to classify regime, direction, volatility, relative coin strength and evidence relevant to the next blind 10-day mission. Never inspect current blind-window candles.

Generate materially different high-velocity hypotheses from persistent MISS/HIT evidence. Optimize coin/pair, regime fit, strategy family, signal frequency, capital use and permitted leverage. Prefer true >=200 HIT probability over capital preservation. Never inspect the current blind window.
Verify novelty, reproducibility, Germany/EWR research-policy compliance, realistic cost/margin/liquidation modeling and zero look-ahead. Reject fake leverage and duplicate fingerprints.

Reveal exactly one previously unseen ten-day window and execute the 100-start aggressive experiment. Leveraged research must include notional-scaled trading costs, borrowing cost proxy, documented liquidation threshold and liquidation fee. A valid economic MISS is learning evidence, not a technical failure.

Judge the complete experiment. HIT only at >=200. On MISS, preserve lesson and restart at raster 1. On the first HIT, save proof and switch to repeatability measurement; never stop the research loop solely because one HIT occurred.

promotion.rule: A run succeeds only when realized simulated capital reaches at least 200 within its blind ten-day window. A MISS remains valid learning evidence but never counts as success. One HIT is a milestone, not proof of repeatability.
